paragraphs: R' Shmuel bar Aivya. See the entry R' Shmuel bar Unia.[^1]

notes.text: Aivya (איביה) and Unia (אוניא) remain distinct supplied patronymics with conventional English vowels. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
